not-found-banner: No members matched the search criteria
session-expired-banner: Your session has ended due to inactivity

steps.title: Open the member search screen
steps.intent: Get to the search form so a member number can be entered.

steps.title: Type the member number into the search box
steps.intent: Put the caller's member number in the field the search reads from.

steps.title: Run the search
steps.intent: Submit the search form and wait for the results grid.

steps.title: Read the member's summary from the results grid
steps.intent: Read the member's name, total share balance and status off the row we searched for.

steps.title: Open the matching member's record
steps.intent: Follow the row whose member number is the one we were asked about.

steps.title: Confirm we are on the right member's record
steps.intent: Re-observe the detail screen and check the subject is still the member we were asked about before anything is read from it.

steps.title: List the member's existing share accounts
steps.intent: Read the share-account grid in the nested frame, bounded.

steps.title: Open the sub-account form for this member
steps.intent: Leave the servicing session on the open-sub-account form for this member, so a teller can complete the write.

steps.title: Confirm the sub-account form is ready for the teller
steps.intent: Check the product list and the deposit field are present and usable before handing the session over.

provenance.goalTemplate: look up member {memberId} in the back office, read their share position, and open the sub-account form for them
